answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in gale and juniper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the marble graph. A farm of 1664 identities would post 3929 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
